items.title: Bitcoin White Paper Turns 18 With Payment Verification Still at Its Core
items.summary: Satoshi Nakamoto introduced the Bitcoin paper on October 31, 2008. Eighteen years later, its central contribution remains a way to verify payment history without a central transaction ledger.

items.title: Ethereum Whale Buys $63 Million in ETH: Smart Money Calling a Bottom?
items.summary: An Ethereum whale buys $63 million in ETH at $2,286 average. Is smart money accumulating as ETH searches for a market bottom?

items.title: One Paper, Infinite Markets: MEXC Marks 18 Years of the Bitcoin Whitepaper by Looking Beyond Bitcoin
items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 2, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, launched its Bitcoin Whitepaper Day 2026 campaign under the theme “One Paper. Infinite Markets.” to mark the 18th anniversary of the Bitcoin whitepaper. Since its publication in 2008, the Bitcoin whitepaper has had an impact far beyond Bitcoin itself, reflecting broader shifts in how value moves, when markets operate, who can participate, and how assets are issued, held, and traded. items.title: Binance Withdrawals Top FTX Levels in November, but Crypto Liquidity Defies Panic
items.summary: Binance withdrawals hit FTX levels in November, but $171B in assets, hack coverage and Bitcoin's resilience point to a stronger crypto market.

items.title: TokenInsight Q3 Report: MEXC Ranks No. 2 in Commodity Perpetuals with 17.43% Market Share
items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 2, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, ranked second in commodity perpetuals trading volume in Q3 2026, capturing a 17.43% market share, according to TokenInsight’s Crypto Exchange Report. TradFi perpetuals accounted for 17.38% of MEXC’s derivatives trading volume, the third-highest proportion among the nine exchanges tracked. The report examined 20 exchanges, including 11 selected for in-depth analysis based on market share, trading volume, and open interest. items.title: Sui Puts Enforced Spending Limits at the Center of Its AI-Agent Design
items.summary: A Sui design note argues that agents need permissions enforced by the systems they use. Onchain transactions can support those controls, but cannot establish that an agent’s objective is correct.

items.title: NEAR Enters Bitwise Large-Cap Indexes in October Rebalance
items.summary: Bitwise’s October 30 rebalance brings NEAR into several indexes, replacing UNI or AVAX depending on the benchmark. Index membership alone does not establish a guaranteed price effect.

items.title: Ethena Pay Adds Earn+ Through Aave V4 Lending on Avalanche
items.summary: Ethena Pay’s Earn+ routes deposits into an Upshift vault curated by Steakhouse and using Aave V4 on Avalanche. The layered structure matters when assessing rewards and withdrawals.

items.title: Circle Asks SEC to Clarify Cash Treatment for Qualifying Payment Stablecoins
items.summary: Circle’s comment letter asks the SEC to align its crypto-asset proposal with payment-stablecoin rules. The company’s requested treatment remains a policy position, not a Commission decision.

items.title: Cosmos Prepares ATOM Tokenomics Review With Separate Governance Proposals
items.summary: Cosmos contributors say tokenomics research has reached the preparation stage for public review. Proposed changes will be discussed individually, rather than treated as an already approved redesign.

items.title: Ambire Ice Puts Safe Owner Changes and Approval Thresholds on the Signing Screen
items.summary: Ambire says its Ice hardware wallet will decode Safe transactions and flag changes to account control. The design targets the decisions signers make before authorizing an action.

items.title: ECB Picks Digital Euro Network Providers as Pilot Infrastructure Takes Shape
items.summary: The ECB has selected two provider groups for digital euro connectivity. The contracts support pilot preparation and possible future issuance, without deciding whether the currency will launch.
